note: Public test keys. Signatures are deterministic ML-DSA-44 (pure, empty context, rnd = 0) over the 32-byte digest. Counters are example values; a digest binds the counters the vault reports. Recovery-lane digests set the policy and execution epochs to zero. A window of 1800 s is the longest accepted.

actions.label: FAST: 0.05 ETH to an allowed recipient with a 0.0005 ETH relay fee (primary alone)
protected: 2 ETH to any address (primary and approver)
approver cancels the protected transfer (approver safety lane)
primary invalidates pending spending (primary safety lane)
approver suspends FAST (execution epoch moved by the invalidation)
new policy: FAST off, 24-hour delay (primary and approver)
cancel the pending policy change (primary and approver)
rotate the primary only; the new key consents (primary and approver)
recovery to a new primary and approver (guardians 1 and 3; both new keys consent)
guardians 1 and 2 cancel the recovery (recovery lane binds the authority epoch only)
replace all three guardians (primary, approver, guardians 2 and 3; each new guardian consents)
